import { z } from 'zod';

import { emailSchema, idSchema, moneySchema } from './common';

/**
 * Order wire schemas. A synthetic stand-in for a real shared contract module:
 * many object schemas, many repeated field names, several enums, and exactly
 * one widened field (`orderItemOutput.fulfilmentChannel`).
 */

export const ORDER_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 25;
export const ORDER_LIST_MAX_LIMIT = 100;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Enums
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const orderStatusSchema = z.enum(['DRAFT', 'PLACED', 'PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED']);
export type OrderStatus = z.infer<typeof orderStatusSchema>;

export const openOrderStatusSchema = orderStatusSchema.exclude(['CANCELLED']);
export type OpenOrderStatus = z.infer<typeof openOrderStatusSchema>;

export const fulfilmentChannelSchema = z.enum(['WAREHOUSE', 'DROPSHIP', 'PICKUP']);
export type FulfilmentChannel = z.infer<typeof fulfilmentChannelSchema>;

export const paymentMethodSchema = z.union([
  z.literal('CARD'),
  z.literal('TRANSFER'),
  z.literal('CASH'),
]);
export type PaymentMethod = z.infer<typeof paymentMethodSchema>;

export const currencySchema = z.literal(['EUR', 'USD', 'PLN']);
export type Currency = z.infer<typeof currencySchema>;

export const sortDirectionSchema = z.enum(['asc', 'desc']);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared building blocks
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** A free-text note. A named string schema, not an enum. */
export const noteSchema = z.string().trim().max(2000);

const addressSchema = z.object({
  line1: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200),
  line2: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),
  city: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100),
  postcode: z.string().trim().min(1).max(20),
  country: z.string().length(2),
});

const auditFields = z.object({
  createdAt: z.date(),
  updatedAt: z.date(),
  createdBy: idSchema,
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Customers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const customerCreateInput = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200),
  email: emailSchema,
  phone: z.string().trim().max(40).optional(),
  billingAddress: addressSchema,
  note: noteSchema.optional(),
});

export const customerUpdateInput = customerCreateInput.partial().extend({
  id: idSchema,
  email: z.string().trim().optional(),
});

export const customerOutput = z.object({
  id: idSchema,
  name: z.string(),
  email: z.string(),
  phone: z.string().nullable(),
  billingAddress: addressSchema,
  note: z.string().nullable(),
  // A string/null union is not a plain z.string().
  preferredChannel: z.union([z.string(), z.null()]),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Orders
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const orderItemInput = z.object({
  sku: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64),
  quantity: z.number().int().positive(),
  unitPrice: moneySchema,
  fulfilmentChannel: fulfilmentChannelSchema.default('WAREHOUSE'),
});

export const orderCreateInput = z.object({
  customerId: idSchema,
  currency: currencySchema,
  paymentMethod: paymentMethodSchema,
  items: z.array(orderItemInput).min(1),
  shippingAddress: addressSchema.optional(),
  note: noteSchema.optional(),
});

export const orderItemRenewInput = z.object({
  orderId: idSchema,
  sku: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64),
  fulfilmentChannel: fulfilmentChannelSchema.optional(),
});

export const orderStatusUpdateInput = z.object({
  id: idSchema,
  status: orderStatusSchema,
  reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
});

export const orderListInput = z.object({
  status: openOrderStatusSchema.optional(),
  customerId: idSchema.optional(),
  search: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(ORDER_LIST_MAX_LIMIT).default(ORDER_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT),
  cursor: z.string().optional(),
  sort: sortDirectionSchema.default('desc'),
});

export const orderItemOutput = z.object({
  id: idSchema,
  sku: z.string(),
  quantity: z.number(),
  unitPrice: moneySchema,
  fulfilmentChannel: z.string().nullable(),
});

export const orderOutput = z
  .object({
    id: idSchema,
    customerId: idSchema,
    status: orderStatusSchema,
    currency: currencySchema,
    paymentMethod: paymentMethodSchema,
    items: z.array(orderItemOutput),
    total: moneySchema,
    shippingAddress: addressSchema.nullable(),
    note: z.string().nullable(),
  })
  .merge(auditFields);

export const orderListOutput = z.object({
  items: z.array(orderOutput),
  nextCursor: z.string().nullable(),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Refunds
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const refundCreateInput = z.object({
  orderId: idSchema,
  amount: moneySchema,
  // Transformed: outputs a number, so it is not a widened string.
  reasonCode: z.string().transform((value) => value.length),
  note: noteSchema.optional(),
});

export const refundOutput = z.object({
  id: idSchema,
  orderId: idSchema,
  amount: moneySchema,
  // Piped into the enum: outputs the enum, not a string.
  status: z.string().pipe(orderStatusSchema),
  note: z.string().nullable(),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type CustomerCreateInput = z.infer<typeof customerCreateInput>;
export type CustomerUpdateInput = z.infer<typeof customerUpdateInput>;
export type CustomerOutput = z.infer<typeof customerOutput>;
export type OrderItemInput = z.infer<typeof orderItemInput>;
export type OrderCreateInput = z.infer<typeof orderCreateInput>;
export type OrderItemRenewInput = z.infer<typeof orderItemRenewInput>;
export type OrderStatusUpdateInput = z.infer<typeof orderStatusUpdateInput>;
export type OrderListInput = z.infer<typeof orderListInput>;
export type OrderItemOutput = z.infer<typeof orderItemOutput>;
export type OrderOutput = z.infer<typeof orderOutput>;
export type OrderListOutput = z.infer<typeof orderListOutput>;
export type RefundCreateInput = z.infer<typeof refundCreateInput>;
export type RefundOutput = z.infer<typeof refundOutput>;
